corporateAddress: Granite Park V, 5830 Granite Parkway, Suite 300, Plano, TX 75024
description: European Wax Center is a waxing-focused franchise founded through its predecessor group in 2006. It operates more than 1,000 retail centers across the United States offering facial and body waxing, hair-removal, and related skin-care services. The current franchisor, EWC Franchisor LLC, is headquartered in Plano, Texas, and operates under Ultimate parent European Wax Center, Inc. New franchisees pay a $45,000 franchise fee with an estimated total initial investment of $327,600 to $836,950, plus a 6% royalty and 3% marketing fund contribution. The franchise agreement runs 10 years with one 10-year successor term, and each center is granted a protected but non-exclusive territory.
territoryDescription: Protected (not exclusive) territory granted after lease acceptance; franchisor will not establish new EWC franchise locations inside it but reserves e-commerce, alternate channels, and acquisition rights. (FDD Item 12, pp.48-50)
territory_terms_text: Protected territory granted after lease acceptance and depicted in a Location Letter; no EWC franchise locations will be established within it, but no exclusivity — you may face competition from franchisees, company outlets, other channels, and acquired competitive brands; e-commerce at waxcenter.com competes (10% revenue-share program for guests visiting a center within prior 12 months)
